meta.notes: Expected strings are browser serializations. kind: valid = specified value, computed = computed value, invalid = must not parse. fuzzy = WPT compares numbers with epsilon 0.01.

tolerance.rationale: WPT fuzzy color comparison epsilon (css/support/color-testcommon.js, default 0.01) applied to every number of the serialization. CSS Color 4 leaves the serialized precision to the implementation above a minimum, so exact string equality with one browser is not a conformance requirement.

legacy-rgb-channels.rationale: Browsers store legacy sRGB colors (rgb(), hsl(), hwb(), named) at 8 bits and serialize rounded integers (hsl(60 100% 37.5%) -> rgb(191, 191, 0)); this library keeps binary64 (191.25). CSS Color 4 section 16.2.2 only requires at least 8-bit precision, so a difference of up to half an 8-bit step on the 0-255 channels of rgb()/rgba() is conformant.
